title: Resolved fee complaint, customer calms down, asks about savings

utterances.text: Thanks for calling, this is Alex -- how can I help today?
I'm still annoyed about these monthly fees, this is the third time I've called.
I completely understand the frustration -- let me look at your account.
Thank you. The refund from last month did help, I'll admit.
I'm glad to hear that. Anything else I can help with today?
Actually yes -- I've been thinking about putting some money aside. Do you have a decent savings option?
Let me check what's available for you based on your account.
Thanks for calling, have a great day!
